text:
Keep them still in a calm room. They're already overstimulated, so I'd clear out the crowd and stop any arguing. Pacing or exercising to "burn it off" only makes more heat, and it raises the risk of their muscles breaking down into the blood, which hurts the kidneys (rhabdomyolysis). If they feel a strong urge to keep moving (akathisia), I'd stay with them and talk them into keeping still anyway.
Give fluids only if they're fully alert, able to swallow and not vomiting, and then just small sips of an electrolyte drink. But if they're confused, vomiting or sleepy, I wouldn't push anything into them, not even pills or charcoal, since they could choke. The same goes if they might have a seizure.
